briefing.en: Final exam of the training wing: collect power, open the door, avoid damaged tiles, and reach the exit with a battery that is too small. Plan the whole route first.
briefing.id: Ujian akhir sayap latihan: ambil daya, buka pintu, hindari petak rusak, dan capai pintu keluar dengan baterai yang terlalu kecil. Rencanakan seluruh rute lebih dulu.

en: Draw the map on paper. Mark H, D, the switch and the charger.
The charger is on the way. The switch is far from the exit.
Loops make long straight runs short.
id: Gambar petanya di kertas. Tandai H, D, saklar, dan pengisi daya.
Pengisi daya ada di jalan. Saklar jauh dari pintu keluar.
Loop memendekkan lintasan lurus yang panjang.

starter: # Plan the whole route before you write code.

objects.event_message: Switch activated. The door is open.

objects.prerequisite_error: The exit is offline. Finish the earlier objective first.
